title: Reuse, Rewrite, or Reject: Evidence-Constrained Trace Reuse for Repeated Mobile GUI Control
abstract: arXiv:2610.31712v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mobile GUI agents frequently perform repetitive tasks with similar interaction procedures. Reusing previous executions can reduce redundant LLM inference and execution overhead, but variations in user instructions and execution environments may invalidate previously successful actions. We systematically characterize these variations into six representative categories and observe that such changes do not necessarily invalidate entire procedures: individual transitions can remain reusable when validated against the current task context and interface state. Based on this insight, we propose graph-text templates for selective execution-trace reuse. The graph captures UI states and action transitions, while the text encodes task intent, procedural structure, and typed slots for variable content. A record-template-replay framework constructs templates from verified executions and leverages the current instruction and live UI state to reuse,

translated_title: 复用、重写还是拒绝：面向重复移动端GUI控制的证据约束轨迹复用
translated_abstract: 移动端GUI智能体经常执行具有相似交互流程的重复性任务。复用先前的执行记录可以减少冗余的大语言模型（LLM）推理与执行开销，但用户指令和执行环境的变化可能使先前成功的操作失效。我们系统地将这些变化归纳为六个代表性类别，并观察到此类变化并不一定会使整个流程失效：在针对当前任务上下文和界面状态进行验证后，单个状态转移仍可保持可复用性。基于这一洞察，我们提出了用于选择性执行轨迹复用的图-文本模板。图结构捕获UI状态和动作转移，而文本编码任务意图、流程结构以及用于可变内容的类型化槽位。一个“记录-模板-回放”框架从经过验证的执行中构建模板，并利用当前指令和实时UI状态来复用……
tldr: 该论文提出图-文本模板与“记录-模板-回放”框架，通过对UI状态转移进行证据约束验证，实现移动端GUI智能体在重复任务中对先前执行轨迹的选择性复用，从而降低冗余的LLM推理与执行开销。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes graph-text templates with a record-template-replay framework that validates individual UI state transitions against the current instruction and live interface state, enabling selective, evidence-constrained reuse of execution traces to reduce redundant LLM inference in repeated mobile GUI control.
